target.title: Fix compaction fallback for OpenAI Responses auth
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #98814.

OpenAI Responses auth already skips incompatible OAuth profiles while walking normal auth order, but compaction can pass the current session profile as an explicit `profileId`. For long direct sessions that inherited an OpenAI OAuth profile, this made `openai/openai-responses` throw before it could reach `openai:api-key-backup`.

This PR adds an opt-in `fallbackOnIncompatibleProfile` flag to provider auth resolution and uses it only from compaction paths:

- embedded transcript compaction
- harness-provided compaction API-key lookup

Default explicit profile behavior remains fail-fast.

## What Problem This Solves

Long-running direct sessions can hit OpenClaw transcript compaction while using `openai/gpt-5.5` through an inherited OAuth profile. The compaction runtime then calls the OpenAI Responses API, which requires API-key auth, but treats the inherited OAuth profile as a locked explicit selection and fails before trying the configured API-key backup. This leaves the session at the context ceiling instead of compacting.

## Evidence

Observed live logs from a direct Signal session showed `compactionTokens=272001` followed by `Auth profile ... uses oauth auth, but openai/openai-responses requires an OpenAI API key profile.` Local installed-dist patch was applied through Hook 50 and OpenClaw restarted successfully; `openclaw status` now reports the gateway reachable and the direct Signal session recovered to roughly `113k/272k` tokens.

Validation run before opening the PR:

- `CI=true pnpm exec vitest run src/agents/model-auth.test.ts`
- `CI=true pnpm exec vitest run src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compaction-runtime-context.test.ts`
- `CI=true pnpm tsgo:core`
- `CI=true pnpm tsgo:core:test`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/model-auth.ts src/agents/model-auth.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compact.ts src/agents/harness/compaction.ts`
- `git diff --check`

## Tests

- `CI=true pnpm exec vitest run src/agents/model-auth.test.ts`
- `CI=true pnpm exec vitest run src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compaction-runtime-context.test.ts`
- `CI=true pnpm tsgo:core`
- `CI=true pnpm tsgo:core:test`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/model-auth.ts src/agents/model-auth.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compact.ts src/agents/harness/compaction.ts`
- `git diff --check`
